title: CONNECT-UDP Datagram Context Work Item
summary: Add CONNECT-UDP UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram and Context ID helpers with focused RFC 9298 proof.
planned_changes:
- Add byte-level UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram codec for Context ID plus payload.
- Add per-request Context ID registry for non-zero dynamic allocation, client/proxy parity, reallocation prevention, and request-namespace scoping.
- Add unknown Context ID, known-MTU discard, DATAGRAM Capsule discard, and future registration policy helpers.
- Add focused tests and canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run focused CONNECT-UDP datagram tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, coverage triage generation, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: ICMP Packet Too Big emission and live PMTU integration.
completion_notes: The RFC 9298 datagram Context ID codec and allocation-policy floor is implemented and verified locally.
